# netactuate_dedicated_devices (Data Source)

Reads Dedicated Devices visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_dedicated_devices" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cores` (String) CPU core count filter.
- `cpu_type` (String) CPU type filter.
- `dc_name` (String) Datacenter name filter.
- `disk_mib` (String) Disk size filter in MiB.
- `disk_type` (String) Disk type filter.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU type filter.
- `nic` (String) NIC filter.
- `per_page` (Number) Maximum number of dedicated devices to return.
- `ram_mb` (String) RAM size filter in MB.
- `region_name` (String) Region name filter.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (List of Object) Dedicated devices matching the filters. Flexible API fields are exposed in raw_json. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `raw_json` (String)
